factors.name: AIOpticalScaleUpOptionality
factors.basis: On 2026-09-21 Lumentum announced a joint Qualcomm/Corning demonstration of a high-density 1060 nm VCSEL optical die-to-die architecture for AI scale-up, adding current ecosystem validation to its optical-interconnect roadmap.

risks: A demonstration is pre-commercial evidence and does not establish design wins, production volumes, pricing or revenue.
unknowns: No production customer, volume ramp, ASP, margin or revenue timing was disclosed.

factors.name: EcosystemExecution
factors.basis: The live ECOC demonstration combines Qualcomm interface IP, Lumentum VCSEL optical interconnect and Corning fiber, evidencing multi-vendor technical integration; commercial conversion remains unproven.

risks: Standards adoption and architecture selection can change before production deployment.
unknowns: No disclosed production qualification or binding purchase commitment.

sources.origin: Lumentum Holdings Inc. with Qualcomm Technologies and Corning
observedFacts: The companies announced a high-density 1060 nm VCSEL optical die-to-die demonstration for AI scale-up architectures.
The board-level demonstration combines Qualcomm interface IP, Lumentum VCSEL optical interconnect and Corning multimode fiber.

recommendation: Reuse as current source-addressed thesis/catalyst/execution evidence, but do not infer commercial economics from a technology demonstration.
